title: Amazing Animal Abilities
summary: Meet animals with super senses, strange homes and clever tricks.

steps.title: Super senses
sentences: Bats find their way in the dark by making high sounds and listening for the echoes.
Eagles can spot a tiny animal from very far away.
Dogs can smell things that people cannot notice at all.

steps.title: Clever builders
sentences: Weaver birds build hanging nests by knotting grass.
Honey bees make neat six-sided honeycomb to store honey.
Termites build tall mud towers that stay cool inside.

steps.title: Staying safe
sentences: A chameleon can change colour to blend into its surroundings.
A porcupine has sharp quills to keep enemies away.
Some animals, like the elephant, live in big family groups that protect each other.

steps.title: Giants and tiny ones
sentences: The blue whale is the biggest animal that has ever lived.
Elephants are the biggest land animals.
The tiniest animals, like some ants and beetles, are smaller than a grain of rice.

facts: An elephant's trunk has tens of thousands of muscles and can pick up a coin.
A hummingbird can flap its wings dozens of times every second.

quiz.q: How do bats find their way in the dark?
quiz.why: Bats make sounds and listen for the echoes that bounce back.

quiz.q: Which is the biggest land animal?
quiz.why: The elephant is the biggest land animal.

quiz.q: Which animal can change colour to hide?
